description: This Java source file defines a REST controller named 'FundTransferController' responsible for handling API requests related to fund transfers in a finance application. It includes endpoints for sending a fund transfer request and reading all fund transfers, utilizing a service 'FundTransferService'.

classes.name: FundTransferController
classes.description: REST controller for handling fund transfer related API requests.

methods.name: sendFundTransfer
methods.description: Handles POST request to execute a fund transfer, logging the request and returning the service response.

methods.name: readFundTransfers
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve all fund transfers with pagination.
